name: away-stretch-inside-window-warns
description: A plant that tolerates 5 dry days, with a 17-day away stretch well inside the 28-day plan window, warns: the stretch outlasts what it tolerates.
why: An away stretch inside the plan window that exceeds the dry tolerance must warn; a stretch that starts near the end of the plan falls outside the window and has nothing to warn about. let_top_dry, interval 7, dry tolerance 5, watered 2026-11-10, away 2026-11-14 to 2026-11-30. Pre-leave watering on 11-13, next free day 12-01: gap 18, 11 past the ideal interval, beyond 1.5 x 5 = 7, so decay. Hand-computed.
